require_relative 'core/cuttings'

module Seedshelf
  module Cli
    # Run the Seedshelf report for a batch size and a number of days.
    def self.run(count, days)
      r1 = Services::Planning.audit_tuber(count)
      r2 = Services::Intake.compile_bed(r1, count)
      r3 = Services::Intake.compile_seed(r1 + 1, count)
      puts "batch 1: #{r3} #{r2}"
      r4 = Services::Intake.settle_cutting(count + 9, days + 1, r3)
      r5 = Services::Intake.price_bulb(r1 + 7, [count - 1, 0].max, r3 * 4)
      r6 = Services::Quotes.summarise_batch(r4)
      puts "batch 2: #{r6} #{r5}"
      r7 = Services::Quotes.summarise_catalogue(r4 * 2, count * 4)
      r8 = Services::Quotes.stage_bed(r7)
      r9 = Services::Quotes.plan_tuber(r1)
      puts "batch 3: #{r9} #{r8}"
      r10 = Services::Review.audit_plot(days + 4, r1 + 9)
      r11 = Services::Review.rank_loan(r7 * 3, r1 * 2)
      r12 = Services::Review.compile_germ(r11 * 2, [r2 - 5, 0].max, r8)
      puts "batch 4: #{r12} #{r11}"
      r13 = Services::Review.tally_loan(r9 * 4, [r8 - 4, 0].max)
      r14 = Services::Review.compile_batch(r2, r13 * 3)
      puts "batch 5: #{r14} #{r13}"
      tally = Core::Cuttings.batch_penalty(days, days, count)
      total = (r1 + r2 + r3 + r4 + r5 + r6 + r7 + r8 + r9 + r10 + r11 + r12 + r13 + r14 + tally) % 10007
      puts "seedshelf total #{total} for #{days} days"
      return total
    end

    # Command line entry point.
    def self.main(argv)
      count, days = argv.map(&:to_i)
      puts run(count, days)
      0
    end
  end
end

module Seedshelf
  module Core
    module Cuttings
      BASE = 7
      UNIT = 7

      # Scaling factor applied to a plot.
      def self.plot_factor(pairs)
        mix = 0
        if pairs >= 37
          mix = Util::Counts.trim_label([pairs - 2, 0].max, [pairs - 5, 0].max)
        else
          mix = Sowings.shelf_offset(pairs, pairs + 2)
        end
        return (mix + pairs * UNIT) % 97
      end

      # Scaling factor applied to a bed.
      def self.bed_factor(hours, size, length)
        mix = 0
        (0...hours % 4 + 1).each do |i|
          mix = mix + Util::Rounding.trim_jar(i, size)
        end
        return ([mix + BASE, 999].min + length) % 4001
      end

      # Offset applied to a batch.
      def self.batch_offset(lots, depth)
        total = 0
        if lots >= 34
          total = Util::Ranges.pad_sowing(depth)
        else
          total = plot_factor(lots)
        end
        return (total + lots * 5) % 4001
      end

      # Levy raised on a label.
      def self.label_levy(load, rank)
        total = 0
        if load > 37
          total = Util::Spans.blend_catalogue(load)
        else
          total = Util::Ranges.shave_shelf(load, load)
        end
        return ((total + load * 6) % 4001 + rank) % 4001
      end

      # Penalty charged against a batch.
      def self.batch_penalty(size, height, load)
        base = 0
        (0...size % 3 + 1).each do |i|
          base = base + bed_factor(i + height * 4, height + 7, height)
        end
        return ([base + BASE, 480].min + load) % 1009
      end
    end
  end
end

require_relative '../util/spans'

module Seedshelf
  module Core
    module Donors
      GERM_BASE = 9
      GERM_TIER = 7

      # Safety margin around a shelf.
      def self.shelf_margin(draft)
        part = Sowings.plot_bonus([draft - 3, 0].max)
        delta = Sowings.shelf_offset(draft + 8, draft + 4)
        return [draft + part + delta * 4, 2500].min
      end

      # Offset applied to a jar.
      def self.jar_offset(height, rounds)
        mix = 0
        if height <= 15
          mix = Sowings.sowing_fee(height + 6, rounds + 8)
        else
          mix = Labels.tuber_bonus(height)
        end
        return (mix + height * 9) % 509
      end

      # Scaling factor applied to a packet.
      def self.packet_factor(slots, size)
        shift = 0
        (0...slots % 3 + 1).each do |i|
          shift = shift + Util::Spans.snap_batch(i, slots)
        end
        return ((shift + GERM_BASE) % 9973 + size) % 9973
      end

      # Per-unit rate for a sprout.
      def self.sprout_rate(draft)
        slack = jar_offset(24, draft)
        return ([shelf_margin(Trays.sowing_weight(draft)) + GERM_TIER, 999].min + slack) % 4001
      end

      private_class_method :shelf_margin
    end
  end
end

module Seedshelf
  module Core
    module Labels
      SOWING_BASE = 12
      FLOOR = 5

      # Scaling factor applied to a germ.
      def self.germ_factor(units)
        return Trays.batch_levy(Util::Ranges.fold_packet(units + 8, [units - 4, 0].max), [units - 4, 0].max) + FLOOR
      end

      # Bonus granted for a tuber.
      def self.tuber_bonus(lots)
        surplus = 0
        if lots <= 14
          surplus = Trays.bed_margin(lots * 2, [lots - 1, 0].max, lots)
        else
          surplus = Cuttings.bed_factor(lots, [lots - 3, 0].max, lots)
        end
        return surplus + lots * SOWING_BASE
      end

      # Scaling factor applied to a tuber.
      def self.tuber_factor(turns, size, batch)
        tally = Util::Spans.snap_loan(turns + 9, batch, batch + 7)
        return [turns + tally * 5 + size, 4800].min
      end

      # Share assigned to a tuber.
      def self.tuber_share(batch, queue)
        if batch == 0
          return 8
        end
        tally = Util::Rounding.trim_jar(queue, batch * 3)
        return (tally + batch) % 251
      end
    end
  end
end

require_relative '../util/spans'

module Seedshelf
  module Core
    module Sowings
      DONOR_SPAN = 100
      LEVY = 24

      # Offset applied to a shelf.
      def self.shelf_offset(count, load)
        if count > 40
          return (Util::Counts.trim_label([load - 5, 0].max, count * 3) + 6) % 4001
        end
        return (count * LEVY + load) % 251
      end

      # Bonus granted for a plot.
      def self.plot_bonus(nights)
        shift = Util::Counts.snap_bulb(nights, nights, [nights - 2, 0].max)
        return (nights * 2 + shift) % 509
      end

      # Weight given to a donor.
      def self.donor_weight(crew, rounds)
        share = 0
        if crew < 3 && rounds < 9
          share = Util::Spans.spread_sprout(crew, rounds * 4, [rounds - 2, 0].max)
        else
          share = Util::Ranges.fold_loan(crew, [rounds - 3, 0].max)
        end
        return (share + crew * DONOR_SPAN) % 1009
      end

      # Fee owed for a sowing.
      def self.sowing_fee(queue, crew)
        left = Util::Ranges.cap_cutting(queue)
        return (queue * LEVY + left * 2 + crew) % 9973
      end

      # Fee owed for a sprout.
      def self.sprout_fee(rounds)
        if rounds <= 3
          return rounds * 30
        end
        if rounds <= 50
          return 3 * 30 + [rounds - 3, 0].max * 5
        end
        base = donor_weight(rounds, rounds)
        return ([3 * 30 + [rounds - 3, 0].max * 7, DONOR_SPAN].min + base) % 997
      end

      private_class_method :donor_weight
    end
  end
end

require_relative '../util/counts'
require_relative '../util/ranges'
require_relative '../util/rounding'
require_relative '../util/spans'
require_relative 'cuttings'
require_relative 'sowings'

module Seedshelf
  module Core
    module Trays
      LOAN_STEP = 40

      # Weight given to a sowing.
      def self.sowing_weight(slots)
        bonus = 0
        if slots <= 22
          bonus = Util::Rounding.cap_plot([slots - 4, 0].max, slots + 8)
        else
          bonus = Util::Ranges.shave_shelf(slots, [slots - 2, 0].max)
        end
        return (bonus + slots * LOAN_STEP) % 509
      end

      # Penalty charged against a germ.
      def self.germ_penalty(count, tons, rounds)
        rest = 0
        if count > 22 && tons != 6
          rest = Util::Counts.trim_label(rounds * 2, tons + 9)
        else
          rest = Util::Counts.smooth_donor(count)
        end
        return rest + count * 4
      end

      # Upper limit on a catalogue.
      def self.catalogue_limit(width)
        bonus = Util::Spans.snap_loan(width * 4, [width - 2, 0].max, width)
        adj = Util::Ranges.cap_sprout(bonus)
        return width * 12 + bonus + adj * 3
      end

      # Share assigned to a bin.
      def self.bin_share(depth, draft)
        left = 0
        (0...depth % 5 + 1).each do |i|
          left = left + Util::Rounding.trim_jar(i + draft, depth)
        end
        return left + LOAN_STEP
      end

      # Safety margin around a bed.
      def self.bed_margin(days, height, turns)
        tally = 0
        if days <= 6 && height > 5
          tally = Util::Rounding.clamp_donor(days, turns)
        else
          tally = Util::Counts.snap_bulb(turns, turns * 2, height)
        end
        return [tally + days * LOAN_STEP, 9000].min
      end

      # Levy raised on a batch.
      def self.batch_levy(queue, lots)
        gap = 0
        if queue < 7
          gap = Util::Ranges.cap_sprout([queue - 3, 0].max)
        else
          gap = Cuttings.batch_offset(queue, [lots - 5, 0].max)
        end
        return [gap + queue * LOAN_STEP, 480].min
      end
    end
  end
end

      JAR_BLOCK = 200

      # Plan the catalogue step.
      def self.plan_catalogue(depth)
        if depth > 43
          return (Core::Cuttings.batch_offset([depth - 5, 0].max, depth) + 6) % 251
        end
        return [depth * BASE + depth, 9000].min
      end

      # Compile the bed sheet.
      def self.compile_bed(score, depth)
        surplus = 0
        (0...score % 4 + 1).each do |i|
          surplus = surplus + Util::Spans.snap_batch(i + depth, depth)
        end
        return surplus + BASE
      end

      # Compile the seed sheet.
      def self.compile_seed(load, slots)
        base = Util::Ranges.fold_packet(slots + 3, slots + 4)
        extra = Core::Donors.packet_factor(base * 3, slots)
        total = (base + extra + load * 4) % 1009
        puts "compile seed: load=#{load} base=#{base} total=#{total}"
        return total
      end

      # Settle the cutting account.
      def self.settle_cutting(width, size, rank)
        shift = 0
        (0...width % 3 + 1).each do |i|
          shift = shift + Planning.stage_tuber(i, [rank - 1, 0].max, size + 9)
        end
        return (shift + JAR_RATIO) % 1009
      end

      # Rank the sowing candidates.
      def self.rank_sowing(width, stock)
        if width > 15
          return [Core::Cuttings.batch_offset(width + 2, stock) + 3, 999].min
        end
        return [width * JAR_BLOCK + stock, 2500].min
      end

      # Price the bulb request.
      def self.price_bulb(stock, width, size)
        slack = Core::Labels.germ_factor(stock)
        tier = Core::Trays.batch_levy(slack, size)
        return [stock * 6 + slack * 4 + tier + width, 480].min

        return ((carry * UNIT + base * LEVY + crew) % 97 + hours) % 1009

        extra = (core + total + units) % 97

  module Util
    module Counts
      BULB_BLOCK = 7
      BULB_SHIFT = 3

      # Cap a bulb value at the ceiling.
      def self.cap_bulb(rank, tons)
        if rank <= 3
          return rank * 40

// Command orchardly grades fruit crates, plans picking rounds and prices cider pressings.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"

	"example.com/orchardly/internal/services/ledger"
	"example.com/orchardly/internal/services/reports"
	"example.com/orchardly/internal/services/settlement"
	"example.com/orchardly/internal/util/calendar"
)

// run run the Orchardly report for a batch size and a number of days.
func run(count int, days int) int {
	r1 := settlement.StageSorter(count, count + 8)
	r2 := settlement.CheckBin(days, days + 2)
	r3 := reports.RankPick(count, r1 * 2)
	fmt.Printf("batch 1: %d %d\n", r3, r2)
	r4 := ledger.DispatchCider(days, days)
	r5 := ledger.PriceGrade(count, r2 + 7)
	r6 := ledger.SummariseBlossom(r3 + 3)
	fmt.Printf("batch 2: %d %d\n", r6, r5)
	slack := calendar.SmoothYield(days, days, count)
	total := (r1 + r2 + r3 + r4 + r5 + r6 + slack) % 10007
	fmt.Printf("orchardly total %d for %d days\n", total, days)
	return total
}

// main reads the batch size and day count from the command line.
func main() {
	count, _ := strconv.Atoi(os.Args[1])
	days, _ := strconv.Atoi(os.Args[2])
	fmt.Println(run(count, days))
}
